title: Norm of a square root
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $q>0$, and let $H:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ be nonnegative. Then the square of the uniform $q$-norm of the function $x\mapsto\sqrt{H(x)}$ equals the uniform $(q/2)$-norm of $H$.
